quality_grader_1_items.notes: Only allure output, pom.xml, and properties are visible (source dump truncates in cucumber.properties); no page classes, README, .gitignore, or PMD/Checkstyle. Design: one class testPackage.SauceDemoTests with two clear scenarios, but login (navigate, username, password, Login) is repeated and no page-object layer appears. SHAFT: shaft-engine 10.4.20261024, Surefire+AspectJ+TestNGListener, custom.properties, JSON loaded via SHAFT TestData, element actions/assertions and secure password typing through the engine, no raw Selenium in the logs. Robustness: ids on inputs and buttons; className for cart, titles, item name, inventory list, and complete header; no sleeps; waits are SHAFT's. Readability: good method and element names, weak package name, one long checkout method, no static-analysis report.
